panels.title: All AP radios — throughput (bits/s, RX+TX)
panels.description: Per-radio wireless throughput across every AP, computed by Prometheus from the VAP octet counters (rate of *_bytes_total × 8) — not any device-reported rate. ng = 2.4 GHz, na = 5 GHz, 6e = 6 GHz.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (name, radio) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_bytes_total[5m]) + rate(unpoller_device_vap_receive_bytes_total[5m])) * 8,"band","2.4 GHz","radio","ng"),"band","5 GHz","radio","na"),"band","6 GHz","radio","6e")

panels.title: All AP radios — errors + drops (per second) — should stay flat at 0
panels.description: Combined TX+RX frame errors and drops per radio (rate of the VAP error/dropped counters). Wireless RETRIES are normal and are NOT counted here — they appear per-AP below. Any line lifting off zero is a real problem.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (name, radio) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_errors_total[5m]) + rate(unpoller_device_vap_receive_errors_total[5m]) + rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_dropped_total[5m]) + rate(unpoller_device_vap_receive_dropped_total[5m])),"band","2.4 GHz","radio","ng"),"band","5 GHz","radio","na"),"band","6 GHz","radio","6e")

panels.title: All AP radios — channel airtime utilization %
panels.description: Fraction of airtime the channel is busy, per radio. This is the best 'is the radio saturated' signal for Wi-Fi (throughput is airtime-bound). NOTE: this one is a device-reported gauge (there is no counter for airtime), unlike the throughput/error panels which are counter-derived.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (name, radio) (unpoller_device_radio_channel_utilization_total_ratio),"band","2.4 GHz","radio","ng"),"band","5 GHz","radio","na"),"band","6 GHz","radio","6e")

panels.title: Airtime breakdown by band — total vs receive vs transmit (avg across APs)
panels.description: Channel airtime averaged over all APs on each band, split into total, receive (airtime spent hearing frames) and transmit (airtime this AP sends). When total ≈ receive and transmit is small, the band is congested by OTHER transmitters (co-channel APs + neighbours), not by this network's own traffic.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(avg by (radio) (unpoller_device_radio_channel_utilization_total_ratio),"band","2.4 GHz","radio","ng"),"band","5 GHz","radio","na"),"band","6 GHz","radio","6e")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(avg by (radio) (unpoller_device_radio_channel_utilization_receive_ratio),"band","2.4 GHz","radio","ng"),"band","5 GHz","radio","na"),"band","6 GHz","radio","6e")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(avg by (radio) (unpoller_device_radio_channel_utilization_transmit_ratio),"band","2.4 GHz","radio","ng"),"band","5 GHz","radio","na"),"band","6 GHz","radio","6e")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(avg by (radio) (unpoller_device_radio_channel_utilization_total_ratio) - avg by (radio) (unpoller_device_radio_channel_utilization_receive_ratio) - avg by (radio) (unpoller_device_radio_channel_utilization_transmit_ratio),"band","2.4 GHz","radio","ng"),"band","5 GHz","radio","na"),"band","6 GHz","radio","6e")

panels.title: 2.4 GHz — channel airtime utilization by AP
panels.description: Total channel busy time per AP on the 2.4 GHz band. The congested band — 9 co-located 2.4 GHz radios + IoT + neighbours.

targets.expr: unpoller_device_radio_channel_utilization_total_ratio{radio="ng"}

panels.title: 5 GHz — channel airtime utilization by AP
panels.description: Total channel busy time per AP on the 5 GHz band. More channels, much cleaner than 2.4 GHz.

targets.expr: unpoller_device_radio_channel_utilization_total_ratio{radio="na"}

panels.title: 6 GHz — channel airtime utilization by AP
panels.description: Total channel busy time per AP on the 6 GHz band. Only the two U7 Pros; a pristine band.
